summary: Madison Air Solutions Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement to issue 90,108,130 Class A common shares at $24.97 per share in a private placement, raising ~$2.25 billion gross. Proceeds will fund the equity portion of its previously announced acquisition of ebm-papst Mulfingen entities. Chairman Larry Gies and affiliate Madison Solutions committed to purchase $300M and $320M, respectively, with other institutional investors covering the balance. The placement is exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and expected to close September 1, 2026, subject to customary conditions, concurrently with the acquisition.
